constraints.name: perrun_main_price
constraints.definition:
CHECK ((amount_cents = (base_amount_cents +
CASE jsonb_array_length(dogs)
    WHEN 2 THEN 18000
    ELSE 0
END)))

constraints.name: perrun_quote_time
constraints.definition:
CHECK (((quoted_at < '2027-01-25 22:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (price_stage =
CASE
    WHEN (quoted_at < '2026-11-01 06:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) THEN 'presale'::text
    WHEN (quoted_at < '2027-01-01 06:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) THEN 'general'::text
    ELSE 'late'::text
END)))

constraints.name: perrun_stage_price
constraints.definition:
CHECK ((base_amount_cents =
CASE price_stage
    WHEN 'presale'::text THEN 45000
    WHEN 'general'::text THEN 50000
    ELSE 55000
END))
